home.title: Open your invitation
home.intro: Paste the link you were sent, or just the invitation code at the end of it.
home.label: Invitation link or code
home.errorEmpty: Paste your invitation link or code.
home.errorInvalid: That doesn't look like an invitation link. Check the message you were sent.

notFound.title: This RSVP page isn't available
notFound.message: The link may be mistyped, or the host has closed replies for this event. If you think this is a mistake, contact the person who invited you.

guest.loadErrorMessage: Check your connection and try again.

form.nameError: Add your name so the host knows who's replying.
form.notesError: This one's required. Write "none" if it doesn't apply.
form.privacy: Only the host sees your reply.

problems.notes_too_long: Please keep your note under 1,000 characters.
problems.rsvp_limit_reached: Sorry, this event isn't taking more replies.
problems.network: We couldn't send your reply. Check your connection and try again.

confirmation.icsHint: Nothing downloaded? Open this page in Safari or Chrome and try again.

admin.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it manually.

login.title: Sign in
login.notAdmin: This account doesn't have admin access.

dashboard.title: Events
dashboard.loadError: Couldn't load events. Check your connection.
dashboard.emptyBody: Create an event to get a link you can share with guests.
dashboard.closed: Replies closed. The link now shows “not available”.
dashboard.updateFailed: Couldn't update the event. Try again.
dashboard.created: Event created. It stays inactive until you switch replies on.
dashboard.createFailed: Couldn't create the event. Try again.

list.loadError: Couldn't load replies. Check your connection.
list.emptyNone: No replies yet. Share the link to start collecting them.
list.confirmBody: This removes it from the list and the counts. It can't be undone.
list.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the reply. Try again.

editor.loadError: Couldn't load the event. Check your connection.
editor.title: Title
editor.codeHint: guests can also type it at {{url}}
editor.addressHint: Shown on the invite, and searched on the map when there’s no map link.
editor.mapLinkHint: Optional. Paste a link from Google Maps, Apple Maps or Waze and “Open in Maps” opens it. Without one, guests get a map search for the address.
editor.languageHint: Language of the labels and buttons around your wording. Write the wording below in the same language.
editor.confirmationHint: Shown after a guest replies. Switch the preview to "Sent" to check it.

switches.acceptingHint: When off, the link shows “This RSVP page isn’t available”.
switches.notesHint: An extra text box under the reply choices.
switches.notesRequiredHint: Guests can't send without filling it in.

editor.deleteHint: Removes the event, all its replies and its images. The link stops working.
editor.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes the event and its {{replies}}. Its link will show “not available”. It can't be undone.
editor.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the event. Try again.

errors.title: Give the event a title.
errors.slugFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.
errors.slugReserved: This link is reserved. Pick another.
errors.slugTaken: Another event already uses this link.
errors.mapLink: Paste a full map link, like https://maps.app.goo.gl/…

editor.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
editor.discardBody: Your edits to this event haven't been saved.

layouts.cardHint: Invite on top, details in a card

fixes.primary: Pick a darker or lighter primary.
fixes.text: Darken the text or change the card fill.
fixes.surface: Make primary and card more different.

look.photoNoCard: With no card, text sits directly on the photo. Pick a card style so the form stays readable.
look.photoNote: The form always sits on the card surface, so it stays readable whatever the photo.
look.uploadFailed: That file couldn't be uploaded. Try a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
look.altHint: If the image has text baked in, summarise it here for screen readers.
look.altWarning: Add alt text so screen-reader users get the invitation too.

preview.title: Preview
preview.inactive: Replies are off, so guests see “not available”. Switch on Accepting replies at the top and save when the invite is ready.
